m6_transfer.revision_diff_and_validity_reason: Previous Oct15 approved list had a historical M6 design-only / limited finite analysis, not a formal complete I/J execution. Seven one-for-one changes include new +1 counter sources The Ooze and Madame Null, Aether Channeler for River Kelpie, and new edict/damage/tutor/removal bodies. Five P0 case concepts were mapped to explicit exact-head finite source-backed tests; eleven P1 cases retain explicit unresolved scoped deferrals because tests do not execute full paid game-state sequences and some source scenario premises include removed River Kelpie. This is transparent bounded transfer, NOT global rules engine or sealed full I/J replay.

P0.payable_fixture: Marchesa present in legal zone, one controlled countered creature dies before end step; compare removed Marchesa and absent counter.
P0.positive_assertion: Current Oracle has death-counter condition and next-end-step return; finite pending trigger predicate true when all preconditions hold.
P0.adversarial_assertion: No counter, no commander, or no death prevents the bounded delayed trigger; not a full priority/stack simulation.

P0.payable_fixture: Countered vs uncountered controlled creature dies with Marchesa present in finite source-bound predicate.
P0.positive_assertion: Only the countered death sets the pending delayed end-step return.
P0.adversarial_assertion: No counter, commander absent, or missing death produces no return; graveyard exile separately guarded.

P0.payable_fixture: Dethrone attacking a 42-life player with 35- and 32-life opponents; compare lower-life and not attacking a player.
P0.positive_assertion: Dethrone predicate permits the highest-life defending player target.
P0.adversarial_assertion: Attack against 35-life opponent while 42 exists, or not against a player, does not meet dethrone predicate.

P0.payable_fixture: Persist Murderous Redcap with one -1/-1 counter and +1/+1 counter reset by relevant on-board source; check zero/one state-bound values.
P0.positive_assertion: Positive predicate: with zero -1/-1 counters persist is eligible; paired +1/+1 and -1/-1 counters net to zero.
P0.adversarial_assertion: Persist is blocked when -1/-1 remains; undying is blocked when +1/+1 remains; no full loop/finitude simulation.

P0.payable_fixture: Countered dead creature with delayed Marchesa return, but opponent exiles the precise graveyard card first.
P0.positive_assertion: Source-bound caveat and predicate correctly reject returning a card that is not in graveyard.
P0.adversarial_assertion: Adversarial graveyard exile leaves graveyard_object_present=false; cannot return missing object. No full game-engine board replay.
